Senior Backend Engineer — Freight Data Platform

Acme Logistics is hiring a senior backend engineer to work on the systems that turn millions of raw carrier events a day into a single reliable shipment timeline.

What you'll do:
- Own the event ingestion pipeline that consumes carrier EDI, GPS telematics and terminal feeds
- Design and build services that reconcile duplicate, late and contradictory events into an ordered history
- Improve the alerting engine that scores shipments for delivery risk
- Mentor two junior engineers on the platform team and take part in design review

Requirements:
- 5+ years building backend services in production, with at least 2 years in Node.js
- Strong SQL and hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale
- Experience with an event streaming system such as Kafka, including ordering and idempotency concerns
- You have designed distributed systems that tolerate unreliable third-party data sources
- Comfortable owning services in production: on-call, monitoring, incident follow-up
- Clear written communication — we are a documentation-first team

Nice to have:
- Experience in logistics, supply chain or another domain with messy real-world data
- Go, which we use for the ingest workers
- Kubernetes operational experience

Location: Rotterdam or remote within CET ±3.

Embedded Signal Processing Engineer

QuietCo is looking for an embedded engineer to work on the signal processing chain that turns raw acoustic traces from our sensors into the feature set our analysis software consumes.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of embedded C or C++ on ARM Cortex-M class hardware
- Solid grounding in digital signal processing: filtering, FFT, windowing
- Experience working with real sensor data and its noise characteristics
- Able to work directly with mechanical and acoustic engineers

Bonus points for:
- Experience with vibration analysis or condition monitoring
- Rust on embedded targets

Based in Stuttgart, on-site three days a week.

Full-Stack Engineer

We need a full-stack engineer comfortable across a React frontend and a Node.js API.

Requirements:
- 4+ years with React, including hooks and modern state management
- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs
- Familiarity with relational databases and schema migration
- Experience mentoring junior engineers

Nice to have:
- TypeScript
- Any exposure to CI/CD pipelines

Data Engineer

Join our data team.

Required: SQL, Python, and experience with a workflow orchestrator such as Airflow.

Staff Platform Engineer

We are looking for a staff-level platform engineer to own our infrastructure end to end.

Requirements (all required):
- 8+ years of backend engineering experience
- Expert-level Go, including the runtime scheduler and escape analysis
- Expert-level Rust for our latency-sensitive proxy layer
- Deep Kubernetes operator development using controller-runtime
- eBPF-based network observability tooling
- Envoy and Istio service mesh configuration at scale
- Terraform module authoring and Terragrunt composition
- PostgreSQL query planning, partitioning and logical replication
- ClickHouse schema design for high-cardinality telemetry
- Kafka partition strategy, exactly-once semantics and consumer rebalancing
- gRPC and Protocol Buffers schema evolution
- OpenTelemetry instrumentation and tail-based sampling
- SLO definition, error budget policy and burn-rate alerting
- Incident command experience for Sev1 outages
- Threat modelling and supply-chain security (SLSA, sigstore)
- FinOps: committed-use planning and per-team cost attribution
- Mentoring staff and senior engineers across three teams
- Writing and driving consensus on org-wide RFCs

Nice to have:
- CNCF project maintainership
- Conference speaking
